name: Vehicle/test-fixture interface base frame
role: Anchors the P0 mechanism to a controlled bench or sled fixture and provides repeatable datum retention.
fabrication: Welded/bolted fixture with replaceable interface plates; exact R4.1 hardpoint pattern is not assumed.

name: Left longitudinal rail/load path S1
role: Guided longitudinal load path for the carriage.
design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED until native CAD geometry is extracted
fabrication: Prototype rail using source geometry envelope; critical bore/axis coordinates from native CAD when exact replication is required.

name: Right longitudinal rail/load path S2
role: Second bilateral longitudinal load path for load sharing/torsional control.
design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED until native CAD geometry is extracted
fabrication: Independent mirror/companion rail with separately measurable reaction path.

name: Seat carriage
role: Moving member translating on 110L/110R and carrying seat/absorber reactions.
design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED / experimentally strengthened where needed for instrumentation
fabrication: Modular plate/frame with bolt-on absorber, lock and rail interfaces.

name: Ride-down energy-management cartridge interface
role: Allows interchangeable energy absorber configurations without changing the structural surrounding architecture.
fabrication: Common clevis/pin interface; cartridge itself is a replaceable test article.

name: Pelvic-control / anti-submarining pan
role: Carries the pelvic guidance/load-distribution geometry used in integrated mechanism studies.
design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED if required for bench article
fabrication: Bolt-on pan to avoid destructive revision after first test.

name: Left seatback rotation-control link
role: Independent mechanical rotation-control path on the left side.
fabrication: Replaceable link with selectable hole/adapter positions only where those positions remain within safe mechanism envelope.

name: Right seatback rotation-control link
role: Independent mechanical rotation-control path on the right side.
fabrication: Independent counterpart to 150L; left/right loads measured separately where practical.

name: Seatback frame
role: Carries torso/head support geometry and the independent rotation-control interfaces.
fabrication: Rigid test frame with replaceable local brackets for 150L/150R and 170/180 as applicable.

name: Multi-state lock/trigger module
role: Tests the mechanical state transition architecture: normal, armed/capture, ride-down, rebound-control, secure/end state as applicable to the embodiment.
fabrication: Modular lock body with replaceable locking/trigger internals and state sensor target.

name: Rebound-control module
role: Controls reverse carriage motion after primary travel.
fabrication: Interchangeable directional-damping or mechanical-control cartridge/stop embodiment.

name: Occupant-restraint interface test mount
role: Preserves the restraint load-path interface for non-human bench/sled studies without making a production anchorage claim.
fabrication: Qualified test anchor hardware or vehicle-equivalent fixture only; no improvised occupant restraint attachment.

name: Torso/head guidance test geometry
role: Provides modular non-occupant surrogate/guide surfaces where trajectory interaction must be studied.
fabrication: Interchangeable rigid/compliant guide plates or surrogate interface; no human-contact use.

name: Sensor/trigger interface panel
role: Carries fixed sensor datums, connector routing, trigger targets and synchronization hardware.
fabrication: Rigid panel isolated from intended moving DOFs; strain-relieved harnesses.

name: Hinge/pivot/bushing/fastener set
role: Creates controlled joint interfaces whose compliance, friction and preload effects can be characterized.
fabrication: Replaceable pins/bushings/washers/fasteners with traceable lot and preload method.
